natural_language_statement: Each of the 31 printed table chunks occupies its exact consecutive position in the original 610-entry certificate array, uniformly over the indices within that chunk.
explanation: The chunk sizes are checked by kernel reduction. Array append lookup lemmas follow the balanced table expression; arithmetic identifies the local index. This proves uniform chunk lookup, so later row checks need evaluate only a chunk of at most 20 entries. These lookup proofs were included in the successful local 12-row probe before local compilation was disabled after the computer freeze.
